description: This file contains server-side code for the UserProfile page in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It retrieves and displays user profile information from a SQL database based on the current session. It also handles navigation actions like going to the dashboard, leaderboard, and logout.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile page, handling page load and navigation button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; fetches user data from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to do something when the profile button is clicked, but currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the Login page, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the TakenCourses page.
